##### Project general facts 

Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers is a landmark residential development set within the iconic Emirates Towers district in Dubai, where sculptural architecture meets refined urban living. Designed in collaboration with SCDA Architects, the tower is defined by its striking cantilevered form and seamless integration into the skyline, appearing to float while framing panoramic views of the city’s most recognizable landmarks. The architecture emphasizes openness, privacy, and elegance, creating a distinctive presence that redefines contemporary sophistication.

The development offers a comprehensive lifestyle experience through a curated collection of premium amenities. Residents can enjoy rooftop sky pools, a private cinema, wellness and fitness clubs, co-working lounges, and dedicated social spaces. Family-friendly features such as pools and recreation areas are complemented by yoga studios, paddle courts, and fine dining venues, all designed to create a balanced environment of relaxation, activity, and exclusivity within a fully serviced residential setting.

Interiors are finished with a refined palette of high-quality materials, including fluted glass, engineered wood, brushed nickel accents, and premium stone surfaces. Thoughtful detailing such as custom joinery, textured wall elements, and elegant countertops enhances the sense of understated luxury throughout each residence. Kitchens come fully equipped with branded appliances, while the apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while maintaining a consistent standard of craftsmanship and design excellence.

##### Location description and benefits

Trade Centre 2 is one of Dubai’s most strategically located and prestigious districts, nestled along the iconic Sheikh Zayed Road. This area serves as a vital commercial corridor and is home to some of the city’s most prominent landmarks, including the Emirates Towers and Dubai World Trade Centre. With its central position, Trade Centre 2 offers unrivaled connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, making it a preferred address for professionals and global travelers alike.

In addition to its business appeal, Trade Centre 2 boasts a refined urban lifestyle. The neighborhood features a mix of luxury residences, five-star hotels, upscale dining options, and world-class shopping destinations. Tree-lined boulevards and landscaped promenades add a touch of tranquility, creating a seamless blend of business energy and residential calm.

Residents of Trade Centre 2 enjoy the best of both worlds—vibrant city life and premium convenience. The area is well-connected by metro and major road networks, with everything from cultural venues to top-tier schools and healthcare just minutes away. Its elevated living standards, architectural landmarks, and central location make Trade Centre 2 a highly desirable community for both residents and investors.
